records.title: Act Wisely: Cultivating Meta-Cognitive Tool Use in Agentic Multimodal Models
records.reason: The contribution is meta-cognitive tool use in agentic multimodal models; its stated focus is tool-use capability, not a concrete inference efficiency or serving technique.

records.title: Visual prompting reimagined: The power of the Activation Prompts
records.reason: Activation Prompts concerns visual prompting for vision models; it is outside the LLM inference efficiency and serving scope.

records.title: Devil is in Narrow Policy: Unleashing Exploration in Driving VLA Models
records.reason: Read the primary driving-VLA exploration method and experiments. The paper expands policy exploration for out-of-distribution driving during policy learning; it is not an LLM inference or serving optimization.

records.title: MC-Search: Evaluating and Enhancing Multimodal Agentic Search with Structured Long Reasoning Chains
records.reason: MC-Search evaluates and enhances multimodal agentic search through structured reasoning chains; the primary abstract focuses on search capability, not inference resource efficiency.

records.title: Dr. MAS: Stable Reinforcement Learning for Multi-Agent LLM Systems
records.reason: Read the primary Dr. MAS RL method and experiments. Its contribution stabilizes multi-agent LLM reinforcement-learning training; it does not report a deployment inference resource/latency method.
